multi-content.title: Observers
multi-content.simple-content: Allow junior developers to observe reviews to learn best practices.

multi-content.title: Secondary Reviewers
multi-content.simple-content: In critical code areas, have multiple reviewers for added scrutiny.

multi-content.title: Up-to-date Branches
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure the feature branch is synced with the main branch to prevent merge conflicts.

multi-content.title: PR Size
multi-content.simple-content: Encourage small, manageable pull requests focusing on a single feature or bug fix.

multi-content.title: Automated Checklists
multi-content.simple-content: Use PR templates with checklists to ensure all submission criteria are met.

multi-content.title: Prioritization
multi-content: Define how urgent fixes are prioritized over feature enhancements.
Set expectations for response times during different project phases.

multi-content.title: Business Requirements
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure the code changes align with business needs and requirements.

multi-content.title: Related Modules
multi-content.simple-content: Check how changes affect other parts of the system.

multi-content.title: Backward Compatibility
multi-content.simple-content: Confirm that changes do not break existing APIs or functionalities.

multi-content.title: Deprecation Notices
multi-content.simple-content: If removing or altering functionality, ensure proper deprecation warnings are in place.

multi-content.title: Quality of Tests
multi-content.simple-content: Evaluate whether tests effectively cover edge cases and potential failure points.

multi-content.title: Integration Tests
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure integration tests are updated or added when necessary.

multi-content.title: Documentation
multi-content: Update API documentation to reflect changes.
Ensure versioning is handled correctly for public APIs.

multi-content.title: Algorithm Efficiency
multi-content.simple-content: Assess whether the most efficient algorithms are used.

multi-content.title: Resource Utilization
multi-content.simple-content: Check for unnecessary resource consumption (memory, CPU).

multi-content.title: Design Patterns
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure appropriate design patterns are applied where beneficial.

multi-content.title: Comments and Documentation
multi-content.simple-content: Verify that complex code segments are well-documented.

multi-content.title: Commit Messages
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure they are descriptive and follow the team's conventions (e.g., Conventional Commits).

multi-content.title: No Sensitive Data
multi-content.simple-content: Verify that no sensitive information (like API keys) is included.

multi-content.title: Input Validation
multi-content.simple-content: Check for proper validation and sanitization of user inputs to prevent injection attacks.

multi-content.title: Authentication and Authorization
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure that secure authentication mechanisms are used and sensitive endpoints are protected.

multi-content.title: Data Privacy
multi-content.simple-content: Verify that personal or sensitive data is handled in compliance with regulations like GDPR.

multi-content.title: Dependency Management
multi-content.simple-content: Check for known vulnerabilities in dependencies and ensure they are updated to secure versions.

multi-content.title: Licensing
multi-content.simple-content: Ensure that all third-party code and libraries comply with the company's licensing policies.

multi-content.title: Regulatory Compliance
multi-content.simple-content: Verify that the code adheres to industry-specific regulations (e.g., HIPAA, PCI DSS).
